parties.respondent: Shriram General Insurance Co. Ltd. & Ors.

summary: Motor accident compensation; amputation of right lower limb above knee; functional disability for gunman role; loss of earning capacity: 100% vs 80%; High Court error in reducing compensation; Mohan Soni precedent applied; tribunal award of ₹34,29,800 restored; calculation error in HC order noted.
legal_provisions_cited: Mohan Soni vs. Ram Avtar Tomar And Others, (2012) 2 SCC 267
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court order set aside; Tribunal award restored; no costs.
